name: add_city_production_progress
description: Add (or subtract, negative) production progress to a city's CURRENT build item via City:GetBuildQueue():AddProgress(n) in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/City.ltp '+20 Production'). Partial alternative to finish_production: e.g. shave turns off a wonder or settler without completing it instantly. Verified live turn 60: +20 on Gniezno's Archer took it from 15 to 7 turns, -20 restored 15 (twice). Params: cityId (required), amount (required, production points; negative removes), playerId (city owner, default local human). Returns the item being built; GameCore has no progress getter, so read the new turn count with get_city (InGame Lua reads of GetUnitProgress/GetTurnsLeft can lag).

playerId.description: city owner id (default local human player)

lua:
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then
  for _, id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if Players[id]:IsHuman() then pid = id break end end
end
local alive = false
for _, id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if id == pid then alive = true end end
if not alive then emitJson({ok=false, error="player not alive: "..tostring(pid)}) return end
local c = Players[pid]:GetCities():FindID(P.cityId)
if c == nil then emitJson({ok=false, error="no city "..tostring(P.cityId).." for player "..tostring(pid)}) return end
local q = c:GetBuildQueue()
local item = q:CurrentlyBuilding()
if item == nil or item == "" or item == "NONE" then emitJson({ok=false, error="city is not building anything", city=c:GetName()}) return end
q:AddProgress(P.amount)
emitJson({ok=true, city=c:GetName(), cityId=P.cityId, playerId=pid, item=item, applied=P.amount, note="read new turns with get_city"})
